headline.text: L1 belt damage, torn screen at L3, and foreign object on pallet — *three* equipment-integrity events flagged for investigation today.

summary: One hold released at L3 (CPK midnight flow-wrap). Three equipment-damage events with FM risk: L1 Matrix 10 belt hole, L3 ML4 Sweco screen torn with dark specs stuck, and foreign object found on L1 pallet by QA. L2 FFS fought pouch-fold issues all shift after weekend startup.

holds.title: CPK midnight flow-wrap hold released
holds.summary: Two LPNs of CPK midnight FW were released from hold after QA disposition — hold tags removed.
holds.status: Resolved — released back to production inventory.

food_safety.title: Matrix 10 blue belt has hole
food_safety.summary: Blue belt (C5) feeding Matrix 10 has a small hole — maintenance notified, scraper disengaged per Eaglestone to prevent worsening until belt replacement.
food_safety.status: Open — scraper disabled, belt still in use pending replacement.

food_safety.title: Foreign object found on pallet
food_safety.summary: Unidentified object found on one of the pallets — QA has the item for investigation.
food_safety.status: Open — QA investigating, object type not yet identified.

food_safety.title: ML4 Sweco screen torn with dark specs
food_safety.summary: North Sweco screen discovered with tear in center and dark specs stuck in mesh that could not be removed — ATP passed but screen not assembled due to condition.
food_safety.status: Open — screen not assembled, awaiting new screen from warehouse (top rack, no forklift driver available overnight).

food_safety.title: Towel used as stopper for ingredient
food_safety.summary: Sweetened condensed milk container found with towel used as stopper in warehouse — contamination risk.
food_safety.status: Open — flagged to production and warehouse supervision for corrective action.

quality.title: S2 X-ray rejecting many pouches
quality.summary: First shift X-ray inspection at S2 jar line rejecting high count of pouches — QA monitoring for root cause.
quality.status: Open — QA following up to identify cause of rejections.

quality.title: FFS pouch fold issues at startup
quality.summary: Fold along bottom and top of pouches after weekend — maintenance troubleshot repeatedly from 06:12 through 08:17, line finally stable mid-shift; second occurrence this startup pattern.
quality.status: Resolved — line running, Alan Todd requested documentation of changes to prevent recurrence.

quality.title: MF Matrix weight 5g over spec
quality.summary: Mid-shift check found maximum piece weight 5 grams above standard — adjustments made and subsequent checks passing.
quality.status: Resolved — adjustments completed, weights back in spec.

quality.title: ML4 open corners on flow-wrap
quality.summary: Case with 403 pieces had 5 pieces open in corners — adjustments made, next case showed 1 open piece with some wrinkled corners but sealed.
quality.status: Resolved — adjustments made, subsequent checks within tolerance.

quality.title: ML1 centerline spec misses
quality.summary: Imperial depositor reported 3 centerlines out of spec, with 4 adjustments outside centerlines recorded on flow-wrap side.

sanitation.title: Multiple corn syrup spills in warehouse
sanitation.summary: Multiple corn syrup spills flagged in main warehouse area from guillotine toward S4 kitchen — sanitation team notified for cleanup.

sanitation.title: Open salt container, no tags
sanitation.summary: Salt on cart found with one container open and no identification tags in warehouse ingredient area.
sanitation.status: Open — flagged to warehouse supervision for labeling and sealing.

opportunities.text: Review warehouse ingredient storage protocols (caps for corn syrup totes, proper sealing/labeling) — based on today's corn syrup spills and towel-stoppered condensed milk container.
Consider belt-integrity inspection cadence for Matrix conveyors — based on today's C5 belt hole discovered mid-shift on Matrix 10.
Document FFS fold-adjustment sequence from today's startup troubleshooting — based on second consecutive Monday pouch-fold issue requiring 2+ hours of maintenance intervention.
Consider adding Sweco screen inspection (tear/contamination check) to ML4 pre-assembly checklist — based on today's torn screen with embedded dark specs discovered after cleaning.
